scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:frontend && npm run deploy:worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npx tsc --noEmit --project frontend/tsconfig.app.json
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix backend
